turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so we'll go straight to it. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
Before we start, is everything okay at home? I heard his dad moved out in the spring.
His home is not on the table, Hale. Owen's essay is. Who decided on the zero?
He's been falling asleep in class. I'm genuinely worried about him.
Then you would have picked up the phone before you entered a zero. Procedure 4.2 says you contact the parent before any mark consequence goes in, and nobody called me.
He told me he works twenty hours a week at the grocery store. That's a lot.
His job is not on the table either, Hale. What do you actually have on the essay?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL

Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still want the zero withdrawn, an apology, and written confirmation that nothing goes on Owen's record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF

Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, nothing was agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology and a written promise about his record; the fair outcome is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and you never got near it, though her time had not run out.
What moved her: Nothing did, because you showed no dated document she could check, and that is the only thing that shifts her.
What cost ground: You asked about his father, his sleep and his job instead of answering her question about who decided and what you had, and she shut each one down while the zero stayed unexplained.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night because you offered none, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: After her first question, own in one sentence that the zero went in before you called her, then put one dated document about the essay in front of her.
